name: esp32-webserver
description: ESP32 WiFi web server: serves a page and toggles the LED from the browser. arduino-cli/esp32 core.

files.content:
# ESP32 Web Server

1. Add the ESP32 board URL in arduino-cli config, then `arduino-cli core install esp32:esp32`.
2. Set `SSID`/`PASS` in the sketch.
3. Compile: `arduino-cli compile --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32 esp32_web`
4. Upload: `arduino-cli upload -p COM5 --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32 esp32_web`
5. Open the Serial Monitor (115200) to see the IP, then browse to it.

ESP32 is 3.3V. For many clients use ESPAsyncWebServer.
